duas.translation: Guide us to the straight path.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid dunya hasanatan wa fil akhirati hasanatan wa qina adhaban nar
duas.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh quloobana ba'da idh hadaitana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah, innaka antal wahhab
duas.translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana faghfir lana dhunoobana wa kaffir 'anna sayyi'aatina wa tawaffana ma'al abrar
duas.translation: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbij 'alni muqeemas salati wa min dhurriyyati, rabbana wa taqabbal du'a
duas.translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
